args.title: Summary: Salt Marsh cold-chain posts (2026)
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/cold-chain/companion):

• Temperature excursions fell 30% in operations where carriers shared live sensor data.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than from less spoilage.
• The companion piece reports that pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (25%).
